zac_language.objection_handling_pattern: Acknowledges the lead's own research directly and confirms it rather than over-selling ('Yeah, well, they're right'); admits gaps in his own knowledge honestly ('No, I don't really [know about SSAS loop]') rather than bluffing; defers the unresolved financing question to the lead's own timeline rather than pushing for a faster decision.

profile_psychology_intersection.recommended_meeting_adjustment: For analytical, certainty-seeking PURCH leads, sequence financing-vehicle mechanics (e.g. SSAS/mortgage eligibility for STL use) BEFORE walking through income figures — Pavol's core blocker was a mismatch between his assumed funding vehicle and STL eligibility rules, not the income model itself, and this only surfaced reactively mid-call after his budget assumptions had already been shared.
